description: Retrieves projects (folders) visible to the authenticated user in a specified Figma team. On plans with nested folders enabled, results include only top-level folders.

team_id.description: Identifier of the Figma team from which to list projects. Note: The `team_id` cannot be programmatically obtained solely from a user token. To find a `team_id`, navigate to a team page you are a member of in Figma. The `team_id` will be present in the URL, typically formatted as `https://www.figma.com/files/team/YOUR_TEAM_ID/Your_Team_Name`.
team_id.title: Team Id

name: get_projects_in_a_team

data.description: Contains the team's name and its list of associated projects.
data.title: Data

projects.description: A list of projects associated with the team.
projects.title: Projects

id.description: The unique identifier for the project.
id.title: Id
